text:
maria: Quick sync — I uploaded the KMS entitlement matrix CSV to /docs/security/kms-entitlement.csv. Need owners for rows 7, 9, and 12 before the sprint review on Thursday. Also: infra/eng-runtime, can you confirm HSM partition availability in eu-west-1? auditlog team, do we have the ingestion schema for envelope metadata?

jake: I can pick up rows 7 and 9. @anita can you take 12? Re: HSM, last we heard capacity is tight. tagging infra-bot for ETA.

infra-bot: Provision request created: PR-452. Current status: queued. Estimated partition allocation date: 2025-03-08 (subject to vendor confirmation). Ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/PR-452 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

anita: I can own row 12 but need the entitlement -> CI service account mapping. maria, can you paste the mapping snippet here?

maria: Pasted mapping below (CSV style):
```
row_id,entitlement,principal_type,principal
7,encrypt_write,service_account,svc-audit-processor
9,decrypt_read,service_account,svc-realtime-ingest
12,sign_token,user_group,security-ops
```

sarah: Audit log schema v2 pushed to repo: https://redwood.internal/audit/schema/v2 — it includes envelope fields: request_id, principal, key_id, action, outcome. Note: timestamp field currently uses ms precision but we want RFC3339 with timezone; filing PR to normalize.

jake: Thanks. Is schema v2 backwards compatible? Any agents still sending old envelope format?

sarah: Mostly compatible. Two producers (svc-legacy-proxy, svc-old-ingest) still emit legacy.envelope. I've opened migration tickets assigned to their owners. Also we need to confirm retention flags for encrypted payloads — legal asked for 7 years for certain tenant data.

kevin: I will run an ad-hoc migration job to reingest sample payloads once infra confirms HSM availability. ETA depends on PR-452 outcome.

maria: Quick checklist/action items from thread: 
- Jake: own rows 7,9 (ack)
- Anita: own row 12 and map entitlements to CI accounts (ack)
- Infra: track PR-452 and confirm final date (infra-bot shows 2025-03-08)
- Sarah: finalize schema RFC3339 timestamp PR and confirm retention flags with legal
- Kevin: standby to run migration tests after HSM partition provisioning

Can everyone add their acceptance criteria to the matrix row comments by EOD tomorrow? If infra date slips, we should surface a canary plan for eu-west-1 traffic (route to eu-central fall-back + note about higher latency). :triangular_flag_on_post:
